label: Own-nature carriage REQUIRES_LACK_1, from carriage REQUIRES_LACK_2 and the sense bridge (inference)
rule: If no determination of the root requires a lack as such, by the bridge none requires it in the root, and carriage in the root applies
meaning: Fix an actual root r, a condition C of its own nature and an admissible q containing its determinations in which no determination of r requires, as such, the lack of members of q. By the sense bridge, none requires such a lack in r either, so own-nature carriage in the root gives C at q. With ownCarriageInFromUnity this is the unity argument's route to carriage as such: everything beyond what the identity thesis supports is in the bridge. The bridge fails for a determination the root shares with a bearer that has the excluded items (simpleUnityCarriageMap, clauses 3 and 4) and is near-analytic for a 'this nature' determination (clause 10). The main theorem uses no axioms.
